Peace Moth, (any relation to Arthur?)

range.

>2. rotscherek: rulin's keep changin, v:tes eliminated it i assume because
>of this. could someone clarify?

>3. what's the next expansion set and will it contain setties and ass's?

The next expansion is Ancient Hearts and will include the Settites and
Assamites. When is unknown.

Messages.Author: James Puzzo
Messages.Body:
Moth (dly...@ksu.ksu.edu) wrote:
: couple ?s r playin circle argues bout, rules are a little unclear and

: we can never agree upon:

:
: 1. when combat is pressed for another round, does range automatically

: resume back at short range or is range continuted where it was at the
: previous round?

You must re-determine range. If neither combatant may maneuver, combat
will be at short range.

: 2. rotscherek: rulin's keep changin, v:tes eliminated it i assume because

: of this. could someone clarify?

The ruling hasn't changed in a LONG time, and then V:TES killed it.
The most recent ruling is that it affects the VAMPIRE DEALING AGGRAVATED
damage.

Messages.Author: B.D. Redmond
Messages.Body:
>> 3. what's the next expansion set and will it contain setties and ass's?
>> and er when?

>> It's supposed to be called Ancient Hearts and will
>be Settites (who will probably replace malks as the premier

>Stealth Bleed deck....

Why?

Settite disciplines are obfuscate, presence and serpentis.

Obfuscate we all know is the major stealth discipline
Presence can bleed, but nowhere near as well as dominate
Serpentis, in Vampire (RPG) is mainly a combat discipline, from memory,
modelled in similar fashion to protean. eg:
Protean Serpentis

Level one: Gleam of the Eyes of the serpent
red eyes
(These two do different things, but the "eyes" theme is there)

Level two: Wolf Claws Serpent's tongue
(Both Agro damage, WC does more damage, but ST allows blood to be
drunk from the attacked creature)

Level Three: Earth Meld Mummify
(Both allow the vampire a state of near indestructability, at the
price of not being able to do much, ie move)

Level four: Form of Wolf/bat Form of serpent
(Spot the difference???)

As for levels 5 and above I can't really remember, it may become different
at the higher levels but I'm fairly sure that level 5 serpentis is similar
to form of mist.

Any comments from WotC about what Serpentis will be like?

Ben

Srealth and Presence allows you to bleed _and_ gain pool!
Social Charm and Legal Manipulations. Also with Dread Gaze
they will have better vote defense. Majsety and Serpentitus
will give them good combat defense as well.
Who knows what the 'corruption' aspects of Serpentitus
will do<g>. Inferior dominate is easier to give them then
Superior presence to Malkavians (for combined pool gain and
heavy bleed). I suggested a Haven uncovered for thier
hoser (at Slugathon to Tom) since no one likes them.
Reveal they are a setite to everyone and then they can be
attacked at +1 stealth, can't remove the hoser from the
target. They will be slower than Malks but better able to
stay in the game (more pool and better defenses) and
giving them dominate isn't that hard.
